Volcano plot for differential expression results

rna_volcano.Rd

Generates a volcano plot from differential expression results stored in the active rna_project. The function visualizes the relationship between effect size (log2 fold-change) and statistical significance (-log10 p-value), highlighting significantly up- and down-regulated genes.

Usage

rna_volcano(
  project,
  genes = NULL,
  top_genes = NULL,
  padj_threshold = 0.05,
  log2fc_threshold = 0.5,
  colors = NULL,
  save = TRUE,
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

project

rna_project object created by rna_project().

genes

Optional character vector of genes to label on the plot. Gene identifiers can be provided either as gene symbols (e.g. "TP53") or as gene IDs matching the rownames of the differential expression results (e.g. Ensembl IDs). Matching is performed automatically using the project annotation, and both representations are supported transparently. When provided, this argument takes precedence over top_genes.

top_genes

Optional integer specifying the number of genes to label automatically based on statistical significance and effect size. Genes are ranked primarily by adjusted p-value (padj) and secondarily by absolute log2 fold-change, prioritizing genes that are both highly significant and strongly regulated. Ignored if genes is provided.

padj_threshold

Numeric. Adjusted p-value cutoff for statistical significance (default 0.05).

log2fc_threshold

Numeric. Absolute log2 fold-change cutoff for biological relevance (default 0.5).

colors

Character. Optional points colors.

save

Logical. Whether to store results in the active rna_project (default TRUE).

verbose

Logical. If TRUE, prints the plot and summary to the console (default TRUE).

Value

An object of class "rna_volcano" containing:

plot

The ggplot object representing the volcano plot.

thresholds

List with padj and log2fc thresholds used.

DEGs

List with vectors of up- and down-regulated genes.

comparison

Comparison ID used to generate the plot.

Details

This function retrieves results produced by rna_compare() and does not perform differential expression analysis itself.

Genes are classified into three categories:

  • Upregulated genes (significant and above log2FC threshold)

  • Downregulated genes (significant and below negative log2FC threshold)

  • Non-significant genes

Significance is defined using the adjusted p-value threshold (padj_threshold), while biological relevance is controlled via the log2 fold-change threshold (log2fc_threshold).

The function supports optional labeling of genes directly on the plot using ggrepel, which is useful for highlighting key markers.

Visualization features

  • Color-coded points (Up, Down, Non-significant)

  • Horizontal line indicating adjusted p-value threshold

  • Vertical lines indicating log2 fold-change thresholds

  • Optional gene labeling for interpretation

Interpretation guidelines

  • Genes in the upper left and upper right quadrants are the most significant and biologically relevant.

  • Symmetry around zero log2FC may indicate balanced regulation across conditions.

  • Large numbers of significant genes may reflect strong biological signal or potential confounding factors (e.g., batch effects).

Side effects

If save = TRUE, the result is stored in the active rna_project under analyses$volcano, along with metadata describing thresholds and comparison used.

See also

rna_compare, rna_sets

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{

# Generate basic volcano plot
rna_volcano(project = my_project)

# Specific gene labeling
rna_volcano(my_project,
            genes = c('gene1', 'gene2', 'gene3')
)

# Top gene labeling
rna_volcano(my_project,
            top_genes = 10
)

# Custom thresholds
rna_volcano(my_project,
            padj_threshold = 0.01,
            log2fc_threshold = 1
)

} # }
